preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= a_{i, j} <= 1023 for all 1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= m
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a non-negative integer less than or equal to 1023.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NIE' or (output == 'TAK' and 1 <= c_j <= m for all 1 <= j <= n)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NIE' if no valid sequence exists, or 'TAK' followed by a sequence of integers c_1, c_2, ..., c_n where each c_j is a valid column index for the j-th row.

postconditions.expression: output == 'TAK' implies a_{1, c_1} XOR a_{2, c_2} XOR ... XOR a_{n, c_n} > 0
postconditions.description: If the output is 'TAK', then the bitwise XOR of the selected elements from each row is strictly greater than zero.
